newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine falls asleep with knife in his neck.
newsitem.headline: Argentine falls asleep with knife in his neck.

text.p: An Argentine farm labourer walked home drunk after a bar brawl and fell asleep for four hours without realising he had a kitchen knife stuck in his neck, Clarin newspaper reported on Monday.
Feeling stabbing pains in his neck when he woke up, Pedro Olivera, nicknamed "the Cat" for surviving three previous stabbings, saw in a mirror that he had a knife buried in his neck up to the hilt.
After Olivera's wife unsuccesfully tried to remove the knife, they called an ambulance. Doctors said Oliver, 36, a labourer, was in intensive care but should survive.
He was unable to help police with their inquiries because he could not remember anything about what went on that night.
